params.description: If present, wpArea is a form object name (Text); if omitted, wpArea is a 4D Write Pro object variable or field.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns the current view properties for the 4D Write Pro area designated by wpArea.
overloadMerges.note: star_operator_dual_signature (category C): both doc syntax lines are one overload where the leading '*' only toggles whether wpArea is a form-object name string or a variable/field reference; merged per the same convention as WA EXECUTE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION / SET LIST ITEM PROPERTIES in the schema examples.

constraints: The command requires wpArea to be associated with a form object currently displayed in the form; if the document is displayed in several form objects, the '*' syntax is required to disambiguate which view to address.
